meta.title: Egyphoria — Egypt, beyond the expected
meta.description: Discover a more personal Egypt. Explore thoughtfully curated day trips and multi-day journeys, or design your own Egyptian itinerary with Egyphoria.
meta.ogDescription: Personal, thoughtfully crafted journeys through Egypt. Explore curated day trips and multi-day escapes, or design your own itinerary — at your own rhythm.

hero.description:
Beyond the landmarks. Into the extraordinary.
Thoughtfully crafted journeys, at your own rhythm.
hero.side: AN ANCIENT WORLD. A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE.

journeys.title:
One country.
Endless ways to feel it.
journeys.intro:
Ancient wonders, slow days on the Nile,
and the places in between.
Find a journey that feels like you.
journeys.note: Every journey is a starting point. Make it yours in our itinerary builder.

way.title:
Not just a place.
A feeling.
way.p1: It's the quiet before a temple opens. The first breeze on the Nile. A conversation that turns a stranger into a friend.
way.p2: We believe the best way to experience Egypt is to make room for it. For its stories, its people, and its wonderfully unexpected moments.
way.point1Text: Your interests. Your pace. A journey shaped around you.
way.point2Text: Iconic places, with time for the everyday magic between them.

behind.title:
Three doctors.
One love for Egypt.
behind.p1: We're Dr. Yahya, Dr. Jimmy, and Dr. Omar. Three doctors who found our way into tourism, brought together by a love for Egypt and the people who come to experience it.
behind.p2: For more than six years, we've been making Egyptian travel experiences better. We bring that same care to every journey—and we're not stopping here. There is always another detail to improve, another way to make your time in Egypt more memorable.
behind.founders: Dr. Yahya · Dr. Jimmy · Dr. Omar
behind.principle:
Every journey is a chance
to make the next one even better.
